text: 11月4日，央行宣布，股票回购增持再贷款的支持对象为21家全国性银行和5家系统重要性城商行，对比来看，此次政策新增了5家系统重要性城商行。梳理发现，宁波银行、江苏银行、上海银行、南京银行和北京银行为新增再贷款支持机构，记者从多位城商行人士处证实了上述消息。（界面）
text_en: On November 4, the PBOC announced that the support targets for the relending facility for stock buybacks and increased holdings are 21 national banks and 5 systemically important city commercial banks. By comparison, this policy newly added 5 systemically important city commercial banks. A review found that Bank of Ningbo, Bank of Jiangsu, Bank of Shanghai, Bank of Nanjing and Bank of Beijing are the newly added institutions supported by the relending facility. The reporter confirmed the above information from multiple city commercial bank sources. (Jiemian)
